Harper: Big news — promoted to Senior Data Engineer and we're expecting a baby in Oct! :tada: :baby:
Jo: WOW congrats x2!!!
Remy: senior data engineer!!! and a baby!!! bring on the cake. when's office picnic?
Harper: thinking a small picnic & cake during lunch on 10/12. open to other dates. also need baby name help — short list so far: Nova, Theo, Lila. thoughts?
Talia: LOVE Nova.
Noor: Theo for the win.
Lin: Lila is sweet. also can someone bring blankets? outdoor picnic logistics = @EventsBot?
EventsBot: Please file an events request to reserve the courtyard and catering allowance: https://company.internal/events-request. Approval usually within 48h.
Jo: Poll for food: 1) Sandwiches 2) Sushi trays 3) Veg-friendly bowls. Reply with number.
Remy: 1
Talia: 3
Noor: 2
Harper: thanks team! i'll submit the request and post a sign-up. appreciate the name help (keep them coming) :heart:
